agenda_items.section: Call to Order and Roll Call:
agenda_items.title: Call to Order and Roll Call:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council amended the agenda to add Items 6B and 8A.

agenda_items.title: Open Comment:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Open Comment opened at 6:10 p.m. and closed at 6:32 p.m.

agenda_items.title: Consent Agenda
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved consent agenda A-I, including the alternate Ordinance 8545 sent out on HOTLINE, 9:0.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to accept the July 28, 2022 Study Session Summary regarding the Hill Revitalization Working Group Update
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council accepted the July 28, 2022 Study Session Summary regarding the Hill Revitalization Working Group Update as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to accept the July 28, 2022 Study Session Summary regarding Reimagining Policing Update
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council accepted the July 28, 2022 Study Session Summary regarding Reimagining Policing Update as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to accept the July 28, 2022 Study Session Summary regarding Xcel Energy Streetlight Acquisition and LED Conversion
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council accepted the July 28, 2022 Study Session Summary regarding Xcel Energy Streetlight Acquisition and LED Conversion as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to accept the May 10, 2022 Special City Council Meeting Minutes
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council accepted the May 10, 2022 Special City Council Meeting Minutes as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to accept the May 17, 2022 Regular City Council Meeting Minutes
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council accepted the May 17, 2022 Regular City Council Meeting Minutes as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of a motion to accept the May 24, 2022 Special City Council Meeting Minutes
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council accepted the May 24, 2022 Special City Council Meeting Minutes as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: Consideration of the following items related to a petition to annex a 0.9-acre enclave property located at 1021 Gapter Road with an initial zoning designation of Residential – Rural (RR-2) (LUR2021-00054): Consideration of a motion to adopt Resolution 1308 setting forth Findings of Fact and Conclusions regarding the annexation of the 0.9-acre enclave property; AND Second reading and consideration of a motion to adopt Ordinance 8532 annexing a 0.9-acre enclave property with an initial zoning designation of Residential - Rural 2 (RR-2) as described in Chapter 9-5, “Modular Zone System,” B.R.C. 1981; amending the Zoning District Map forming a part of said Chapter to include the property in the above-mentioned zoning district; and setting forth related details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council adopted Resolution 1308 and Ordinance 8532 as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: Introduction , first reading and consideration of a motion to order published by title only of Ordinance 8544 Amending Section 9-2-19, “Rezoning,” B.R.C. 1981, by adding rezoning standards to implement the East Boulder Subcommunity Plan and Setting Forth Related Details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council ordered Ordinance 8544 published by title only on first reading as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: Second Reading and consideration of a motion to adopt by emergency measure Ordinance 8545 amending Sections 2-1-2, “Council Meetings,” 2-2.5-11, “Location and Special Procedures for Governing Body Meetings and Departments,” and 2-3-1, “General Provisions,” B.R.C 1981, allowing for boards, commissions, and City Council members to attend meetings virtually or in-person; and setting forth related details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the alternate Ordinance 8545 sent out on HOTLINE as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: Call-Up Check-In
Public Hearings
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council considered the continued ballot ordinances and adopted the Arapahoe Avenue annexation items.

agenda_items.title: Continued second reading of the following ballot items:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council amended and passed Ordinances 8534, 8546 and 8542 and continued Ordinances 8539 and 8540.

agenda_items.title: Continued second reading and consideration of a motion to amend and pass Ordinance 8534 submitting to the registered electors of the City of Boulder at the Special Municipal Coordinated Election to be held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, the question of whether to repeal Ordinance 8483 regarding the annexation of CU South ; specifying the form of the ballot and other election procedures; and setting forth related details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council amended and passed Ordinance 8534; the recorded vote was 9:0 with Speer listed as abstaining.

agenda_items.title: Continued second reading and consideration of a motion to continue Ordinance 8539 submitting to the registered electors of the City of Boulder at the Special Municipal Coordinated Election to be held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, the question of whether to amend Sections 65, 102 and 130 and repeal Sections 69, 132, 133, and 134 from the Boulder Home Rule Charter if the initiative to create a library district on the Boulder County Ballot is approved at this election ; specifying the form of the ballot and other election procedures; and setting forth related details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council continued Ordinance 8539 by a 9:0 vote.

agenda_items.title: Continued second reading and consideration of a motion to continue Ordinance 8540 submitting to the registered electors of the City of Boulder at the Special Municipal Coordinated Election to be held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, the question of whether to amend Sections 5 and 9 of the Boulder Home Rule Charter to prohibit running for more than one office at an election, allow a council member whose term does not expire at the election to run for mayor in the election, fill a vacancy for the expired term, and change the swearing-in date of newly elected officials ; specifying the form of the ballot and other election procedures; and setting forth related details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council continued Ordinance 8540 by a 9:0 vote.

agenda_items.title: Continued second reading and consideration of a motion to amend and pass Ordinance 8546 submitting to the registered electors of the City of Boulder at the Special Municipal Coordinated Election to be held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, the question of whether to amend Sections 5, 14 and 22 of the Boulder Home Rule Charter to change the regular municipal elections of candidates to even-numbered years beginning in 2026; implement the transition by reducing the terms of the council members elected in 2023 and 2025 to three years and increasing the term of the mayor elected in 2023 to three years; specifying the form of the ballot and other election procedures; and setting forth related details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council amended and passed Ordinance 8546, then reconsidered it and amended and passed it with the requested amendments, each by a 6:3 vote.

agenda_items.title: Continued second reading and consideration of a motion to amend and pass Ordinance 8542 submitting to the registered electors of the City of Boulder at the Special Municipal Coordinated Election to be held on Tuesday, November 8, 2022, the questions of authorizing the City Council to replace the existing utility occupation tax and climate action plan excise tax with a new climate tax beginning January 1, 2023, and expiring December 31, 2040, and authorizing debt to be repaid from such tax up to a principal amount of $52,900,000 to meet the city’s climate goals; specifying the form of the ballot and other election procedures; and setting forth related details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council amended and passed Ordinance 8542 by a 9:0 vote.

agenda_items.title: Public hearing and consideration of the following items related to a petition to annex a 1.087-acre property generally located at 302 Arapahoe Ave. and 334 Arapahoe Ave. (LUR2021-00003): Consideration of a motion to adopt Resolution 1314 setting forth Findings of Fact and conclusions regarding the annexation of a 1.087-acre property; AND Second reading and consideration of a motion to adopt Ordinance 8522 annexing to the City of Boulder a 1.087-acre property with an initial zoning designation of Residential Medium - 3 (RM-3) as described in Chapter 9-5, “Modular Zone System,” B.R.C. 1981; amending the Zoning District Map forming a part of said Chapter to include the property in the above-mentioned zoning district; and setting forth related details
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council adopted Resolution 1314 and Ordinance 8522 by a 9:0 vote.

agenda_items.title: Matters from the City Manager
Outdoor Dining Update
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Chris Jones, Community Vitality Director, provided a presentation and answered questions from Council.

agenda_items.title: Disposable Bag Fee Changes and Single-Use Plastics
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Jonathan Koehn, Climate Initiatives Director and Jamie Harkins, Sustainability Senior Manager provided a presentation and answered questions from Council.

agenda_items.title: Matters from the City Attorney

agenda_items.section: Matters from the Mayor and Members of Council
agenda_items.title: Matters from the Mayor and Members of Council

agenda_items.section: Matters from the Mayor and Members of Council
agenda_items.title: Living Wage Update
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council unanimously supported engaging staff and continuing work on the project.

agenda_items.title: Discussion Items
Debrief
Adjournment
agenda_items.outcome_summary: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, by motion regularly adopted, the meeting was adjourned by Mayor Brockett at 10:18 p.m.
